name: Catalog games: Redis maintenance
description: Redis maintenance gate on CQ9 is visible in the catalog while platforms.maintain remains 0.

queries.name: station
queries.sql: SELECT id, code, cost_percent FROM stations WHERE code = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

queries.name: platforms
queries.sql: SELECT id, name, active, maintain FROM platforms WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

queries.name: game_companies
queries.sql: SELECT id, name, platform_id, platform_name, currency FROM game_companies ORDER BY id

queries.name: station_companies
queries.sql: SELECT sgc.id, sgc.game_company_id, sgc.game_company_name, sgc.active, sgc.currency FROM station_game_companies sgc JOIN stations s ON s.id = sgc.station_id WHERE s.code = ? AND sgc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sgc.id

queries.name: games
queries.sql: SELECT id, code, active, maintain FROM games WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

queries.name: game_currencies
queries.sql: SELECT game_id, currency, status FROM game_currencies WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
